package groupchat

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"fiatjaf.com/nostr"
	"github.com/iDoris-ai/hyphae/internal/common"
	"github.com/iDoris-ai/hyphae/internal/messaging"
	"github.com/iDoris-ai/hyphae/pkg/types"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// Run only in an archive of the pinned integration tree, using its test helpers.
func TestCaptureLegacyNilRelays(t *testing.T) {
	dest := os.Getenv("F2A_FIXTURE_DIR")
	require.NotEmpty(t, dest)
	for _, group := range []bool{true, false} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{true: "group", false: "dm"}[group], func(t *testing.T) {
			t.Setenv("HOME", t.TempDir())
			sender, recipient := newMember(t), nostr.Generate()
			recipientNpub := common.EncodeNpub(recipient.Public())
			payload := "isolated F2a DM fixture"
			name := "legacy-dm-nil-relays"
			key := FanoutKey{LocalNpub: sender.npub, GroupID: mustOpaque(t), EnvelopeType: EnvelopeMessage, SendKey: mustOpaque(t)}
			if group {
				name = "legacy-165-group-nil-relays"
				var err error
				payload, err = Encode(Envelope{Type: EnvelopeMessage, Version: Version, GroupID: key.GroupID, LogicalID: key.SendKey, Body: "isolated F2a group fixture"})
				require.NoError(t, err)
			}
			event := testAgentEvent(t, payload, sender.sk, recipient, true)
			eventJSON, err := json.Marshal(event)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if group {
				insertTestFanout(t, sender, key, recipientNpub, RecipientPrepared, event.ID.Hex(), string(eventJSON), "", 0)
				report, err := sender.store.EnqueuePrepared(key)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.Equal(t, 1, report.Queued)
				row, err := sender.db.Query(`SELECT local_npub, group_id, envelope_type, send_key, recipient_npub, event_id, event_json, queue_id, state, issue, relay_acks, relay_count, attempts, max_retries, created_at, updated_at, accepted_at FROM groupchat_fanout`)
				require.NoError(t, err)
				columns, err := row.Columns()
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.True(t, row.Next())
				values, pointers := make([]any, len(columns)), make([]any, len(columns))
				for i := range values {
					pointers[i] = &values[i]
				}
				require.NoError(t, row.Scan(pointers...))
				snapshot := map[string]any{}
				for i, c := range columns {
					snapshot[c] = values[i]
				}
				require.NoError(t, row.Close())
				rawRow, err := json.MarshalIndent(snapshot, "", "  ")
				require.NoError(t, err)
				require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dest, name+".row.json"), rawRow, 0600))
			} else {
				require.NoError(t, messaging.AddToOutbox(&types.Outbox{}, &event, recipientNpub, nil))
			}
			path, err := messaging.GetOutboxPath()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Contains(t, string(raw), `"relays": null`)
			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dest, name+".json"), raw, 0600))
			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dest, name+".event.json"), eventJSON, 0600))
		})
	}
}
